subject: POC planning & final readout - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's demo - Redwood POC planning

Hi Jordan -

Thanks again for taking time today - appreciated the thoughtful questions from the AI and Data team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

- Agreed POC scope: evaluate Redwood for clinical note summarization and cost/perf vs current pipeline (throughput and latency at 256 tokens).
- Success criteria (initial): 1) >=95% critical info recall on our clinical test set; 2) mean latency <300ms for 256-token responses at 10 qps; 3) integration with existing HL7-derived payloads.
- Proposed timeline: technical kickoff week of Aug 10, 2-week trial (Aug 10- Aug 24), final readout week of Aug 24-28 and executive decision week of Aug 30.
- Owners: Marissa (Redwood lead), Marcus (tech lead), Jordan (Acme program lead), Leslie (procurement).

I've attached a short MVP_success_criteria_template.xlsx to capture metrics and testsets. Can you confirm the criteria and stakeholders above, and whether Aug 10 works for the kickoff?

Next actions:
1) Jordan - confirm success criteria & procurement contact (Leslie)
2) Acme ops - provide test dataset access pattern and expected qps
3) Marcus/Marissa - share mutual action plan and environment requirements

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: MVP_success_criteria_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leslie Park <leslie.park@acme-health.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's demo - Redwood POC planning

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the items below and adding a few clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: agree with your three bullets. We'll add a qualitative reviewer score (physician acceptability >= 4/5 on 50 sampled cases).
- Timeline: Aug 10 kickoff works. Final readout window of Aug 24-28 is fine - we'll try to lock exec reviewer availability for Aug 25.
- Stakeholders: Myself (program lead), Priya Reddy (eng lead), Leslie Park (procurement).

Procurement note: Leslie will own the contract/PO. She requested that we include a short SOW + estimated spend for their internal approval.

I also attached a short summary of our required data export format and access constraints. We'll need a plan for redacted PHI transfer or use of synthetic data for the first run - Priya will coordinate with your tech team.

Jordan
Jordan Smith
Director, Product - Acme Health
jordan.smith@acme-health.com

Attachment: acme_data_requirements.pdf (doc stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Leslie Park <leslie.park@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: POC plan & Mutual Action Plan (draft)

Jordan/Team -

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out ownership, success criteria, timeline, and tech prerequisites. Highlights:

1) Trial dates: Aug 10- Aug 24 (14 calendar days).
2) Evaluation plan: Redwood will run A/B comparisons against your current pipeline across the provided testset. We'll report: recall on critical fields, physician acceptability, mean latency, and cost/token.
3) Roles & owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa (program owner), Marcus (tech), Neha (solutions architect for eval harness)
   - Acme: Jordan (program), Priya (eng), Leslie (procurement)
4) Environment/access: we will provide a temporary, isolated test endpoint in Redwood Dedicated with logging/audit. For PHI concerns, we recommend synthetic data or redacted payloads for the first pass - see section 4 in the MAP.
5) Deliverables: mid-trial check-in (Aug 17), final readout deck (by Aug 24), exec readout (Aug 25 preferred).

Please review the MAP and the attached PDF. If that looks good, I'll send a calendar invite for the kickoff on Aug 10 and loop Marcus and Neha into the technical thread.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_Acme_Health_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme-health.com>, Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Technical kickoff & access checklist

Hi Priya/Jordan -

Thanks for kicking this off. Quick technical checklist so we can confirm environment access before we start:

- API keys & IP allowlist (we will provide temporary keys and ask for allowlist entries)
- Example payloads (redacted/synthetic) - please share by EOD Aug 11
- Test harness: Neha will share a lightweight evaluation harness repo and an access token for results upload
- Monitoring hooks: audit logs and latency traces will be available on the Redwood console; we'll share read-only access.

If we get these items by Aug 11 we can proceed with the trial run as scheduled tomorrow. Attached is a short access_checklist.md with exact fields we need.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: access_checklist.md (text stub)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme-health.com>, Leslie Park <leslie.park@acme-health.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-17T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & Mutual Action Plan (draft) - mid-trial check-in

Team -

Quick mid-trial update: things look promising on our side. Initial qualitative checks show good summaries; latency numbers are within range at the target qps. Two items for next week:

1) Executive readout: we'd like to lock Aug 25 as the exec review date (internal sponsor and decision-makers available that day). Can Redwood commit to a 30-45 minute readout + recommendation?
2) Contracting: Leslie asks for a short SOW + estimated spend (ballpark for procurement) so she can start internal approvals - they prefer a single-year committed pricing with a trial-to-paid transition.

If Aug 25 works, we'll expect a final deck a day before (Aug 24) and a short summary slide with go/no-go recommendation and next commercial step (SOW/PO).

Thanks - Jordan

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Leslie Park <leslie.park@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final readout on Aug 25 - deck + SOW next steps

Jordan/Leslie/Priya -

Aug 25 works on our side for the exec readout. We'll run a 30-minute session with the following agenda: 1) Trial summary & metrics, 2) Demo of representative outputs, 3) Recommendation & next commercial steps.

Action items from Redwood:
- Marcus/Neha: produce the final readout deck and demo (will share draft by Aug 24).
- Marissa: draft short SOW and ballpark pricing for Leslie to start procurement - will share initial SOW by EOD Aug 19.

Leslie - can you confirm preferred SOW/PO format (line item vs. committed monthly spend)? We'll adapt the draft accordingly.

Attaching a draft of the final readout deck; this is an early version and we'll incorporate your data and comments.

Looking forward -
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Final_Readout_Deck_draft.pptx (pptx stub)
